TEXT: Several years later...
A lot has happened...
But with the blessings of our friends, we finally tied the knot.
Our days of happiness were passing in the blink of an eye and little by little, our daily lives were changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, it's about time, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes, it is. Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Oh, why the old nickname?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I was recalling the time when we had just met.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Geh...
I don't know what he was remembering, but my husband's face turned pale.
No matter how many years it's been, that expression always looks so childish. I couldn't help but laugh a bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Haha, what did you remember?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: One of those times when you high-kicked me with a demonic expression on your face.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, want me to kick you for old times' sake?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't. It's bad for your body.
He hasn't changed at all. He's still a lecher, an idiot, a pervert, a siscon...
And a very kind person.
The one I love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You know, I never thought we'd actually get married.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: When we first met, I didn't even imagine it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes, me too.
He proposed to me soon after he got a job at a local company.
He declared his love for me in front of my parents, as he had once done for Kirino.
Then...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: I'm back!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh! Hey, Kirino, don't just barge in here. Advertise your presence like a normal person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ehehe, I wanted to surprise you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How old are you? Still a kid?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Sorry, sorry. Oh yeah, souvenir for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Kirino! Long time no see!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ayase! Long time no see! How've you been?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Just fine! It's great to see that you haven't changed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course. Just who do you think I am?
With that, my best friend smiled at me just like she did in the past.
Kirino, now all grown up, radiated a beauty that made me lose myself in fascination for a moment.
She's currently enjoying life as a pro model in Europe.
She came back to Japan today, after several years abroad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But you know... Your stomach's gotten pretty big. It's due soon, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes. It's a girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh! A girl! I see. I guess I'll stay in Japan for a while then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh, really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course. I want to be second after you to see my niece's face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't be stupid. The second to see her is me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh? But I want to!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...She's as selfish as always.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Not really. But soon enough, you'll be an aunt.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wait! T-T-T-That's... something you should never say to a girl!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, you two... Don't start fighting right away after not seeing each other for so long.
I smiled as I rebuked them for their never-ending bickering.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey, you too... When the baby's born, you'll be a dad, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: And... Ayase will be a mom.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Dad will be a grandpa, Mom will be a grandma. But all I get to be... is an aunt? *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: The passing of time is pretty scary.
Kirino smiled stiffly as her shoulders dropped in resignation.
Onii-san put a hand on her head, a wry smile on his face.
In the past, this would've made me jealous... Now, I see it as a symbol of happiness.
Watching these siblings get along, I gently rubbed my swollen stomach and silently prayed.
May these peaceful days never end.
